known_elements: curved, armoured optical heart rate sensor lens
adjacent_references: US 2018/0054563 A1 (discloses a machine learning-based signal processing system for reducing motion artifacts), US 2019/0154441 A1 (describes a dynamic calibration system for heart rate monitoring)
inventive_step: The combination of a machine learning-based signal processing system, a dynamic calibration system, and a curved, armoured optical heart rate sensor lens to adaptively reduce motion artifacts caused by arm movement and muscle contractions is a key differentiator.
search_universe_limitation: The search universe was limited to patents and publications related to wearable heart rate monitoring devices and signal processing systems, but did not include a comprehensive search of all relevant databases and grey literature.
